title.zh: 修正第133号法案的法案，该法案题为《修正第83号法案〈省级政府法〉的法案》，规定凡受雇于美利坚合众国陆军部或海军部的文职雇员，若非受雇前即为群岛居民，而是为履行该职务被带至群岛者，可免缴户籍税
title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered One Hundred and thirty-three, Entitled "An Act to Amend the Provincial Government Act, Numbered Eighty-three," By Providing that a Civilian Employee in the Permanent Employment of the War or Navy Department of the United states, Who Was Not a Resident of the Islands Before His Employment in Such Service, Hut Was Brought Here for the Purpose of Such Employment, Shall Be Exempt From the Payment of a Cedula Tax.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 133 có tựa đề “Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Chính quyền Tỉnh số 83”, quy định rằng nhân viên dân sự làm việc thường xuyên tại Bộ Chiến tranh hoặc Bộ Hải quân Hoa Kỳ, nếu không cư trú tại Quần đảo trước khi được tuyển dụng nhưng được đưa đến Quần đảo vì mục đích tuyển dụng đó, sẽ được miễn nộp thuế thẻ cư trú
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ ๑๓๓ เรื่องพระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติการปกครองจังหวัดฉบับที่ ๘๓ โดยกำหนดให้พนักงานพลเรือนที่มีการจ้างงานถาวรในกระทรวงสงครามหรือกระทรวงนาวีของสหรัฐอเมริกาซึ่งไม่ได้เป็นผู้พำนักในหมู่เกาะมาก่อนการจ้างงานแต่ถูกนำมายังหมู่เกาะเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ในการจ้างงานดังกล่าวได้รับการยกเว้นจากการชำระภาษีเซดูลา
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 133 berjudul “Undang-Undang Mengubah Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi Nomor 83”, yang menetapkan bahwa pegawai sipil yang bekerja tetap di Departemen Perang atau Departemen Angkatan Laut Amerika Serikat, yang tidak tinggal di Kepulauan sebelum dipekerjakan namun dibawa ke Kepulauan untuk tujuan pekerjaan tersebut, dibebaskan dari pembayaran pajak cedula
title.ms: Akta Mengubah Akta Nombor 133 yang bertajuk “Akta Mengubah Akta Kerajaan Negeri Nombor 83”, dengan menyediakan bahawa seorang pekerja awam dalam pekerjaan tetap di Jabatan Perang atau Jabatan Tentera Laut Amerika Syarikat yang bukan penduduk Kepulauan sebelum diambil bekerja tetapi dibawa ke Kepulauan bagi tujuan pengambilan bekerja tersebut dibebaskan daripada pembayaran cukai cedula

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-three, entitled "An Act to amend the
Provincial Government Act, Numbered Eighty-three," shall be amended by adding to subsection twenty-six
thereunder, after the word "navy" in the eighth line of subsection, the following: "or a civilian employee in the
permanent employment of the War or Navy Department of the United States, who was not a resident of the
Islands before his employment in such service, but was brought here for the purpose of such employment," so
that the said subsection shall read as follows:
"Section 26. There shall be collected in each province, by the provincial treasurer, an annual tax of one peso
or one dollar, Mexican, to be called the ceduia or registration tax, from every male person of eighteen years of
age and not more than fifty-five years of age residing in such province, whether a native of the Phihppine
Islands, a citizen of the United States, or a foreigner, except a soldier, sailor, or officer of the United States
Army or Navy, or a civilian employee in the permanent employment of the War or Navy Department of the
United States, who was not a resident of the Islands before his employment in such service, but was brought
here for the purpose of such employment, a member of a non-Christian tribe, or a foreign consular officer
exempted by treaty or international law."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission in
the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 1, 1903.
